analyst_view.overall: Early view: Ajax drew 2-2 at Twente after five straight wins and host ADO four days before Thun in the Conference League and a week before the Klassieker, so Michel may rotate (Ajax change the most starters in the league). ADO sacked Robin Peter on 2 November and won 3-1 against Sparta under interim Levi Schwiebbe; Voetbal International reports Maurice Steijn is set to return as coach, not yet confirmed by the club when I checked.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.6 goals. Ajax have the league's in-form striker in Tolu Arokodare, and ADO have conceded 25 in 12, but Ajax often lack control and a new-coach lift for ADO could make them harder to break. I stay with the estimate.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. I lean higher: Ajax build much of their threat around crosses for Tolu's headers, and ADO, playing away with possibly a new coach, will likely sit deep and concede corners.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards. No bans or rivalry issues stand out; ADO's tactical fouls against a dominant home side fit the away-heavy split.

shots.text: The numbers say 34.1 shots, 23.5 for Ajax. I lean lower: Ajax were outshot for long spells at Twente and with Thun and Feyenoord coming, Michel is likely to rotate.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target. ADO's keeper Kilian Nikiema made key saves against Sparta but plays for Burkina Faso as late as 17 November, and five other ADO players are also away on international duty. Ajax should create enough to reach the estimate, so I keep it.
